# Datta Sable
> Senior Business Intelligence Developer, Enterprise Data Engineer & Data Strategy Consultant specializing in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, Python data engineering, and autonomous AI workflows.

Datta Sable provides production-grade architectural blueprints, deep-dive technical tutorials, and enterprise consulting for modern data and analytics stacks. With over 10 years of experience designing and deploying scalable analytics infrastructure, Datta helps organizations transform raw transactional and operational data into high-fidelity, decision-ready analytics pipelines.

- Website: https://dattasable.com
- Location: India (Consulting Globally)
- Core Competencies: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Synapse Data Engineering, Delta Lake, OneLake, DAX Optimization, SQL Window Functions, Python Data Pipelines, Autonomous AI Agents, SEO Architecture.
- Certifications: DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate), DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate), PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst Associate), DP-800.

## Essential Foundations & Guides
- [Start Here - Top 6 Architectural Foundations](https://dattasable.com/start-here): Hand-picked deep dives establishing core architectural intuition across data engineering and BI.
- [Microsoft Fabric Architecture Explained](https://dattasable.com/blog/microsoft-fabric): End-to-end exploration of OneLake, Lakehouse engines, Polaris SQL Warehouses, and Direct Lake semantic modeling.
- [Psychology of High-Fidelity Dashboard Design](https://dattasable.com/blog/high-fidelity-dashboard-design): Applying cognitive load theory, pre-attentive attributes, and focal hierarchy to turn cluttered reports into decision tools.
- [PL-300 vs DP-600 vs DP-700 Certification Blueprint](https://dattasable.com/certification): Comprehensive breakdown of syllabus, exam strategies, and career roadmaps across Power BI and Fabric.
- [Zero-Trust Data Quality & Automated Validation](https://dattasable.com/blog/zero-trust-data-quality): Implementing automated schema assertions, range validations, and Python interceptors before data hits production.
- [Mastering Autonomous AI Agent Workflows](https://dattasable.com/blog/autonomous-ai-agents): Constructing supervisor-router agent topologies, preventing infinite API failure loops, and managing token context budgets.
- [The Modern BI Stack Blueprint](https://dattasable.com/blog/modern-bi-stack): Objective architectural evaluation of cloud data lakes, semantic caching layers, and decoupled visualization stacks.
